import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,base64
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd()
for source,page,name in [('occupancy',20,'occupancy-figure5'),('kempe',5,'kempe-figure1'),('kempe',6,'kempe-figure2')]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1000','-singlefile','-png',str(p/'sources'/ (source+'.pdf'))],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 b=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(); w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/'+name+'.png','--base64'],input=b,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('IMAGE:'+b)
